tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Dell 0F29535 12TB SAS 12G 3.5-Inch Hard Disk Drive is a high-performance enterprise storage solution engineered for modern data centers, servers, cloud infrastructure, and business-critical applications. With a massive 12TB storage capacity, 12Gb/s SAS interface, and enterprise-grade reliability, this hard drive is ideal for organizations that require dependable, scalable, and secure data storage.

Designed for continuous 24/7 operation, the Dell 0F29535 delivers exceptional performance for virtualization, database management, backup systems, surveillance storage, and large-scale enterprise environments. Its advanced SAS technology ensures faster data transfer rates, improved reliability, and enhanced data integrity compared to traditional SATA drives.

Whether you are upgrading your existing server infrastructure or expanding storage capacity, the Dell 0F29535 12TB SAS HDD provides the performance and durability needed for demanding workloads.


Key Features


  • Massive 12TB Enterprise Storage Capacity
  • High-Speed 12Gb/s SAS Interface
  • Standard 3.5-Inch Form Factor
  • Enterprise-Class Reliability and Durability
  • Optimized for 24/7 Continuous Operation
  • Ideal for Servers, Storage Arrays, and Data Centers
  • Enhanced Data Integrity and Error Protection
  • Suitable for Virtualization and Cloud Environments
  • High Capacity for Backup and Archiving Applications
  • Compatible with Various Dell Enterprise Servers
